issues.surface: Manage › Schedule › event cards (Open now, Confirmed, private events — cards with the right-hand action icons)
issues.detail: The details column is squeezed to 96–103 px by the date column and 4 action icons. '11:30 AM–10:45 PM' (≈135 px) cannot fit even with no van name, so it breaks after the dash; with ' · Big van' it takes 3 lines and leaves 'van' alone on the last line (GB '11:30–22:45' fits on one line without a van, 2 lines with one). Fine from 800 px up (one line at 800/810/1180/1280).
issues.measured: time line 2→3 lines (40→60 px); card 144→164 px (+20 px) on Market Square, The Old Crown (8:00 PM–12:30 AM), Community Centre; single-van truck: 1→2 lines
issues.frequency: every US event card on a phone, every time the Schedule tab is opened
issues.fix: put the time range on its own full-width line below the venue (or move the action icons to a row under the card on phones), keep each time + AM/PM unbreakable, and put the van on its own line

issues.surface: Manage › Schedule › 'Needs confirmation' card (operator-added unconfirmed event, 5 action icons incl. ✓ Confirm)
issues.detail: The details column is only 68 px wide, so the range breaks INSIDE a time: '11:30' / 'AM–' / '10:45 PM' / '· Van 1'. The start time is split from its AM marker. GB: '11:30–' / '22:45 ·' / 'Van 1' (3 lines).
issues.measured: time line 3→4 lines (60→80 px); card 184→204 px (+20 px); details column 68 px for a 181 px line
issues.frequency: every operator-added event waiting for confirmation, on a phone
issues.fix: non-breaking space between the time and AM/PM (break only after the dash); same layout fix as C-01 (time on its own full-width line or icons below)

issues.surface: Manage › Schedule › Add / Edit event (also Approve → Edit) › Start time / End time hour boxes
issues.detail: Each hour box leaves 16 px for its label (the wrapper's border + px-3 around a select with its own px-2 + pr-7 chevron room). US hour labels are '11 AM', '10 PM', '8 PM', '12 AM': the AM/PM is cut off entirely, so 11:30 AM – 10:45 PM shows as '11 : 30' – '10 : 45' and an 8:00 PM – 12:30 AM event shows '8 | : 00' – '12 : 30' (reads as 8 o'clock to half past noon). GB labels are 2 digits and lose only 3 px.
issues.measured: label needs 38–45 px in a 16 px text box: 22–29 px cut ('11 AM' 43/16, '10 PM' 45/16, '8 PM' 38/16, '12 AM' 45/16); GB '22' 19/16 (3 px). At 800/810 the box is 43 px (US needs 38–40, fits); at 1180/1280 83 px
issues.frequency: every event a US truck adds or edits on a phone (and every Approve that needs times)
issues.fix: drop the inner select's own border/padding inside the wrapper (or a single 12-hour select per time, e.g. '10:45 PM', or an AM/PM toggle beside the minute box), or stack start and end on separate rows on phones

issues.measured: time 1→2 lines (12→24 px); preview card 82→88 px (+6 px); 800/810/1180/1280 all affected

issues.fix: widen the card's date/time column or let the range break after the dash with times kept whole (or drop the spaces around the dash)

method: scripts/us-layout-audit/C-manage/render.cjs bundles the REAL app/manage/[token]/page.tsx (ScheduleTab, SettingsTab, BillingTab) and components/manage/PaymentsTab + ChargesCard + TakingPaymentPanel with scripts/_render-kit.cjs (useState patches, Supabase stubbed, createPortal inlined), renders them to static HTML for Pizza Kitchen (test-truck) in GB (GBP, en-GB, Europe/London, 24h) and US (USD, en-US, America/New_York, 12h, sales tax 8.875% exclusive, tips on, service fee 3% + $0.30 within a 4% + 50¢ cap) at Wednesday 30 September 2026 11:50 local (kit.setNow 10:50Z / 15:50Z, setDeviceTz, setDeviceLocale), with providers from scripts/_lp1d-fixtures.cjs and Settings props/vans from scripts/_lp1d-settings.cjs; the shell trial popup comes from scripts/_lp1d2-shell.cjs. Fixtures: events 11:30–22:45, 20:00–00:30 (confirmed and pending), an operator-unconfirmed event, a private event, a conflicting pending event, two vans; editor open on 11:30–22:45 and on 20:00–00:30; import review with three found events; pre-order daily cut-off 12:45; collection intervals 15/5 min; Billing trial ending 30 Sep and Max with the matrix open. Each view is painted in Playwright WebKit with the compiled .next CSS and Geist fonts (served on 127.0.0.1 by scripts/screenshots/common.cjs serve) in a browser context with the country's locale and time zone, at 390×844, 810×1080, 800×1280, 1180×820 and 1280×800, and measured in the page (line counts from height/line-height, select label width via canvas vs the select's content width, scrollWidth − clientWidth, card heights). scripts/us-layout-audit/C-manage/sheets.cjs builds sheets 07–09 from the measured boxes.
